title: Blinded (status group)
html:
This page is about the status group. For the condition, see Blinded (Condition).

Blinded is a status group. This group includes vision-impairing status similar to  Blinded. While blinded by one of these conditions, many reactions will be unavailable such as  Opportunity Attack,  Hellish Rebuke, or  Deflect Missiles. Creatures who do not rely on vision will generally be immune to all blinding conditions.

Removal

The following items remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Remedial Potion
  • Arrow of Salving
  • Noblestalk
  • Jhannyl's Gloves

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Lesser Restoration
  • Heal

Immunity

The following items grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Eversight Ring
  • Steelwatcher Helmet
  • Helldusk Helmet
  • Shar's Spear of Evening

The following passive features grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Blindsight
  •  Born into Darkness
  •  Shar's Sight

The following creatures possess immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Bat
  •  Dryad (Conjure Woodland Beings)
  •  Guardian of Faith
  •  Spiritual Weapon
  •  Sharran Fidelian
  •  Sharran Novice
  •  Sharran Sentry
  •  Dark Justiciar
  •  Shadow Creeper
  •  Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight
  •  Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound
  •  Shadow-Cursed Vine Blight
  •  Intellect Devourer
  •  The Netherbrain
  •  Tentacle

The following conditions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Spore Servant

List of conditions in Blinded

Condition Effects
Blinded
  • The affected creature has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
  • Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution Saving Throw. If successful, the condition is removed.
Blinded
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
Blindness
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected creature rolls a  Constitution Saving Throw against the Spell Save DC of the casater. If successful, the condition is removed.
Colour Spray
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
Miasmic Mists Aura
  • At the start of Cazador's turns, this creature may become  Blinded and take 3d6⁠⁠Necrotic while within 4 m (13 ft) of the vampire.
Stricken With Blinding Sickness
  • Fingernails of searing pain dig into the affected entity's eyes. It has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and  Saving Throws, and is also Blinded.
Stricken with Malice
  • Affected entity is Blinded and Poisoned.
  • Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and its range of attacks and spells is reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Ability Checks.
